title: Etihad passengers to get free Abu Dhabi medical travel cover
excerpt: Source: Gulf News International visitors flying to Abu Dhabi on Etihad will automatically receive complimentary medical travel insurance for up to 15 days from July, giving travellers an added layer of cover during their stay in the UAE. The insurance will apply to eligible Etihad-operated flights from July through December 2026, with no application required.
